name: Asou Junko
source:
The mysterious figure that had been observing Kazuki from afar ever since the power-out in school in the beginning. What could she possibly be up to?

She's actually [spoiler]a police officer belonging to the Tokyo Metropolitan Police's Counter-Cyberterrorism  department, alias "Cyberforce". Her hair is a long immaculate silver ponytail, and she's an adult lady possessing both really strict, but at the same time a very gentle personality. She's quite adept at martial arts and at the usage of firearms.[/spoiler]

[Edited from a [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/03/09/hello-world-review/]review[/url] by Warum]
